content.short: Hardhat is a flexible and diverse Javascript-based framework for Ethereum blockchain developers.
content.description: Hardhat is a widely used Javascript-based development environment for building Ethereum-based decentralized applications. It streamlines smart contract development by automating routine tasks and offering a comprehensive set of features designed to boost productivity. The platform provides a pre-built local Ethereum network tailored for Solidity development, together with an extensive suite of plugins and built-in debugging tools that help developers test, debug, and deploy contracts more efficiently.
